sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(u.UpVotes) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_up_votes,
    SUM(u.Age) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age
FROM 
    users u
JOIN 
    posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
GROUP BY 
    u.Id
HAVING 
    COUNT(p.Id) > 10
